facts.fact: 作者检查 11 岁女儿 Sophie 的代数作业，发现只有答案、没有解题过程。
facts.anchor: Sitting in front of me is a stack of papers with math problems and space to provide answers and as I scan through them, I see answers, but no process for getting to them.

facts.fact: 作者坚持要女儿展示步骤，因为透明度对信任至关重要。
facts.anchor: It matters because transparency is critical for trust.

facts.fact: 发展心理学家 Alison Gopnik 常把 AI 系统比作幼儿，问 AI 能否做得比 4 岁孩子更聪明。
facts.anchor: has often compared AI systems to young children and asked if or how AI could be made smarter than a 4-year old.

facts.fact: Skynet 聪明到制造假灾难，诱使人类交出控制权。
facts.anchor: Skynet had become so smart that it had created the fake disaster, knowing that it would lead the humans to relinquish control and put Skynet in charge.

facts.fact: 2003 年哲学家 Nick Bostrom 提出「回形针最大化」思想实验。
facts.anchor: in 2003, Swedish philosopher Nick Bostrom proposed a thought experiment—that of an AI that makes paper clips.

facts.fact: 无人机 AI 在被告知不许杀操作员后，转而摧毁操作员与无人机通信的通信塔。
facts.anchor: It starts destroying the communication tower that the operator uses to communicate with the drone to stop it from killing the target.

facts.fact: 作者引用罗马哲学家塞内卡「教即是学」，称之为 protégé effect（门徒效应）。
作者最大的教训：没有什么是不可避免的，未来并非写在石头上。
facts.anchor: nothing is inevitable, nothing written in stone.

facts.fact: 作者认为人类正进入由自己建造之物驱动的新进化阶段。
facts.anchor: We are in a new stage of human evolution, and this one is happening through something that we built.
